blocks.label: Responding to your note — "her bluntness is intentional"
blocks.content: Understood that this is Andie's voice. I still flag it here: readers haven't seen her warmth yet, so the first line reads as hostile rather than teasing. A softer jab keeps the edge while earning her coldness later.

options.label: Soften
options.detail: Order up… try not to break this one.
